captions.detailed: A full-floating rear axle assembly featuring a wide, central differential banjo housing in dark gray. Extending from the central housing are two cylindrical axle tubes fitted with mounting pads, transitioning into lighter gray spindle sections. At each outer end, a hub assembly with a bolted flange plate is attached, complete with a circular pattern of small black retention studs. The hubs are designed to spin relative to the axle housing on revolute bearing interfaces.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a full-floating rear axle assembly with a central differential banjo housing, mounting pads on the axle tubes, and rotating hub assemblies with bolted flange plates at the spindle ends.
captions.factory: Construct the main axle housing using a central cylinder combined with a larger, rounded banjo shape for the differential. Add cylindrical axle tubes extending symmetrically along the lateral axis, and attach rectangular mounting pads on top. Model the outer spindles as smaller concentric cylinders, and cap them with larger hub flanges. Generate a circular pattern of small cylinders on the flanges to represent the bolted studs.
